MANDARIN CHINESE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MANDARIN CHINESE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Details ● Active listening ● Note-taking.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Details ● Active listening ● Note-taking.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Details ● Active listening ● Note-taking.
